summary: Fix host-harness compilation by adding missing kernel u8/u16/u32/u64/s32/s64 typedefs and min/max helpers; remove blanket -w suppression. Align host tests with driver/RTL behavior: reject mode4 all-zero weights early, enforce METHOD feature mask 0xf in preflight and extra_validate, add missing E2/METHOD wrong-caps preflight tests, retain FREEZE abort-bit MMIO semantics, and add reverse source-integrity fault injection. Preserve old ABI functions and avoid unrelated source rewrites.

tests: Both harnesses must compile without unknown u8/u16/u32/u64/s32/s64 and pass all checks.
Config harness now exercises mode4 all-zero weight early rejection, E2 missing-feature/version preflight rejection, and METHOD feature-mask 0xf preflight rejection.
Reverse harness now verifies reverse tail union, corrupt tail rejection, corrupt source rejection, forward prefix union, and reverse/forward batch collect accounting.
risks: Assumption: policy_mode 4 is the weighted mode requiring at least one non-zero weight; if additional modes are weighted, extend the mode check accordingly.
Assumption: credit_cap must be >= max_budget per existing driver validation; the mode6 test now sets credit_cap=200000 for the max_budget=200000 case.
Removing -w may surface warnings; the harnesses do not use -Werror, so warnings alone should not fail the tests.
The min/max macros in the reverse harness may double-evaluate arguments in expressions; reviewed call sites use side-effect-free arithmetic.
FREEZE abort-bit retention was already present in the supplied fake MMIO model; no change was needed, but CLEAR still clears ABORT/FROZEN/ARMED as required.
Driver validator changes are limited to the requested mode4 all-zero weight rejection and METHOD feature-mask 0xf enforcement; no DMA ordering/drain code was touched.
